issues.explanation: Chapter 10 ends with Chen Gong urging Cao Cao to stop, then says only that his advice failed; it omits his departure to Zhang Miao. Chapter 11 later has Chen Gong advising Lu Bu and presents Lu Bu's attack on Yan province without explaining how Chen Gong and Lu Bu came into Zhang Miao's alliance or why the attack was initiated.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a brief bridge at the end of Chapter 10 or start of Chapter 11: Chen Gong left Cao Cao, joined Zhang Miao, and persuaded him to ally with Lu Bu while Cao Cao was campaigning in Xu province.
